author: Retro Game Corps
description:
Retroid has announced their next two handhelds, the Pocket Duo and Pocket Duo Lite. Here's a roundup of all the information we know so far.

** Pre-order launch time: Sept 11th at 9:30pm ET (6:30pm PT) **

Retroid Pocket Duo: https://tinyurl.com/RGC-RPDuo
use code "DUO" for $20 off during pre-order phase
shipping starts mid-October

Retroid Pocket Duo Lite: https://tinyurl.com/RGC-RPDuo-Lite
use code "DUOLITE" for $14 off during pre-order phase
shipping starts Sept 17th

Other handhelds mentioned:
